templates.source: Sercomm RC8120 Compact Wireless Network Camera User Manual (manualslib.com/manual/2397199, Appendix B 'Network Camera HTTP CGI', p.87): RTSP media streaming URL 'rtsp://<ip>/img/media.sav' returns video and audio. Default RTSP port is 554 (same manual, p.46: 'Enter 554 for RTSP port number in the Network screen'). Same img/*.sav RTSP scheme appears across Sercomm's RC-series camera manuals (RC8111/RC8221) which share the same OEM firmware.

Sercomm RC8120 User Manual (manualslib.com/manual/2397199, Appendix B 'Network Camera HTTP CGI', p.87): 'rtsp://<ip>/img/video.sav' returns video only (audio-only companion is 'rtsp://<ip>/img/audio.sav'). Note: the HTTP M-JPEG stream on these cameras is a separate path (http://<ip>/img/mjpeg.htm and http://<ip>/img/video.mjpeg, p.83-84), NOT the RTSP video.sav path.

notes: Sercomm is a Taiwanese ODM/OEM (sercomm.com) that builds network cameras for service providers and SMB brands. Its RC-series camera firmware documents a fixed RTSP scheme in the 'Network Camera HTTP CGI' appendix: rtsp://<ip>/img/media.sav (video+audio), rtsp://<ip>/img/video.sav (video only), rtsp://<ip>/img/audio.sav (audio only), with an accompanying HTTP SDP at http://<ip>/img/media.sdp. Default RTSP port 554. The candidate 'img/video.sav' from the scan DB is the documented video-only RTSP path; '/live', '/stream_1', '/stream_2' are generic and not documented by Sercomm.
